universal_lens: Composite energy function unifies visual, elastic, and motion cues for robust player tracking in far-view soccer videos via variational inference. Composite energy function integrating HSV hue and HOG shape descriptors for far-view soccer player tracking.

The motion component enforces temporal consistency by penalizing sudden directional changes. These three energies are combined into a total energy function, which is minimized to obtain optimal player positions across frames. This formulation allows for principled integration of domain knowledge (formation behavior, motion smoothness) with low-level visual cues, resulting in improved tracking performance in challenging far-view scenarios. The method demonstrates effectiveness through empirical validation on real-world soccer footage.
